lyrics:
[Intro: bright analog synth riff, racing drum machine, gated snare]

[Verse 1: smooth, urgent, pulsing synth bass]
Called you once and I hung up twice
Drove a circle round the same advice
Every sign says slow it down
I'm the only car in town

[Pre-Chorus: drums thin, pad swells]
And the radio's all static and regret
I can't stand the quiet yet

[Chorus: full beat, synth riff answers every line]
I'm running every red
To get to where you are
The whole town's gone to bed
I'm a comet in a car
I can't see, I can't see past the glow
Tell me stop or tell me go
I'm running every red

[Verse 2: smooth, a little rueful]
I'm too old for a midnight drive
Got a knee that knows when the rain arrives
But you said "come," one little word
Fastest thing I ever heard

[Pre-Chorus: drums thin, pad swells]
And the radio's all static and regret
I can't stand the quiet yet

[Chorus: full beat, synth riff answers every line]
I'm running every red
To get to where you are
The whole town's gone to bed
I'm a comet in a car
I can't see, I can't see past the glow
Tell me stop or tell me go
I'm running every red

[Bridge: half-time, falsetto, drums drop to kick]
I'm only coming back to say I'm sorry
I ran out of yellow lights to hurry
Leave the door, leave the door

[Synth Solo: the riff an octave up, drums return]

[Final Chorus: everything, falsetto ad-libs]
I'm running every red
To get to where you are
The whole town's gone to bed
I'm a comet in a car
I can't see, I can't see past the glow
Tell me stop or tell me go
I'm running every red

[Outro: synth riff alone, engine ticking, stop]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 171 BPM, 4/4, F minor. A racing, nocturnal pulse. Euphoric on the surface, anxious underneath.

VOICE: Male tenor, smooth and light, with an easy falsetto. Verses sung close and slightly breathless. Chorus doubled and wide. The bridge is in falsetto with long reverb. Wordless falsetto ad-libs over the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: A bright, brassy analog synthesiser playing a short, catchy riff that returns between vocal lines. A drum machine with a fast, straight beat and a big gated-reverb snare. Pulsing eighth-note synth bass. Wide, glassy synth pads. A shimmering arpeggio in the chorus. No guitars.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the synth riff over the drum machine. 0:11 Verse 1. 0:28 Pre-chorus. 0:39 Chorus 1. 1:07 Verse 2. 1:24 Pre-chorus. 1:35 Chorus 2. 2:03 Bridge in half time. 2:20 Synth solo, the riff an octave higher. 2:31 Final chorus with ad-libs. 2:59 Outro, the riff alone, the sound of an engine ticking as it cools, ending at 3:15.

PRODUCTION & MIX: A modern recording dressed as 1985: analog-style synths and gated drums with present-day sub-bass, loudness and stereo width.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The synth riff in the first three seconds.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The driver has a bad knee and knows better. The need is the same one, felt by someone with more to lose, which makes the bridge's apology land.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Restlessness, pursuit, remorse, arrival.
